issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the UML/problem statement specifies a parameterless method public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(), but the solution implements public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests). This mismatch means the reference implementation and UML/API expected by students/tests disagree about the method signature and will confuse students which method to implement and how tests will call it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent. Change the solution (and update the template) to provide the parameterless method signature required by the UML: public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() that returns numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents. If the boolean option for excluding/including guests is desired, add it as an overload (e.g. public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests)) while keeping the parameterless method to match the problem statement and tests. Alternatively, if the parameterized behavior is the intended API, update the problem statement/UML to document getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) and adjust the template/tests accordingly.
